messages:
Samir - Marketing: Hey team — prepping assets for the May 14 webinar + launch post. Need a small pack from design by EOD Wed. Deliverables: 1) Webinar hero slide (16:9) with headline + 2-product screenshots, 2) Benchmark microtile (square) showing cost/latency comparison, 3) One-page sales PDF (A4) with 3 callouts & CTA, 4) Social squares (2 sizes) and 2x tweet-ready copy variants. Also need brand-check and accessibility pass. Linking figma frames: https://figma.com/file/xyz (can we reuse benchmark palette from bench-kit?)

Ava (Design): Got it. Can you drop the final benchmark numbers and the headline copy? Need exact copy for the hero. Also prefer Figma export sizes. :+1:

Samir - Marketing: headline options: "Serve powerful LLMs with predictable latency and cost" OR "Production LLM inference that scales — predictably." Bench numbers: median latency 55ms @ 2k tokens, 2.3x cost savings w/ prefix cache + batching vs baseline. Social CTAs: "See the benchmark" and "Get a quick demo". Use primary brand palette and the new sparse-grid icon set.

Lina (Growth): Quick ask — for the one-pager can we include 1) inbound lead routing steps and 2) suggested GTM snippet for SDRs? Jamal will need the HubSpot fields.

Jamal - Sales: For HubSpot, route to queue: "Inbound - Bench Webinar"; required fields: company, estimated monthly tokens, primary use case. If design has space, add 1-line "What we'll ask on demo" checklist.

Ava (Design): Cool. For benchmark microtile — do we want a bar chart + sparkline or an icon-led stat card? Bar chart is clearer for cost but needs clean numbers. Also accessibility note: if we use red/green, prefer patterns rather than color alone.

Riley (PM): Bar + sparkline recommended. Use 60% width bar for baseline costs, 26% for Redwood-optimized path (visual should show 2.3x improvement). Sparkline shows latency distribution.

FigmaBot: Export frames queued: web-hero@16:9 (2x), microtile@1:1 (2x), onepager@A4 (pdf), social@1:1(2x), social@4:5(2x). ETA 4 hours.

Ava (Design): Noted on accessibility. I'll add pattern overlays and alt text for each deliverable. Quick question on legal: can we call out exact model names in the one-pager? DesignOps Bot: Please confirm with Legal if naming older community models; otherwise use "open and curated models."

Samir - Marketing: Hold on model names — Legal flagged one community model earlier. Use generic phrasing for now: "curated open models + Redwood-verified variants." We'll sync with legal tomorrow.

Lina (Growth): For inbound copy on forms: "Tell us about your inference scale" (dropdown: prototyping / < 1M tokens / 1M–10M / 10M+). That'll help route to Dedicated vs Hosted SDR playbooks.

Ava (Design): Perfect. I'll design the form mock as a small inset on the one-pager. Any localization needs?

Samir - Marketing: Yep, Spanish & German variants later in the week — for now deliver english masters only. We'll request localization after sign-off.

Jamal - Sales: Also add a tiny section: "Target verticals" with checkboxes (SaaS, Marketplace, Enterprise). Helps SDR triage.

Ava (Design): Understood. Delivering initial drafts by EOD Wed. Will post links here when uploaded. :rocket:

FigmaBot: Exports complete. Preview links: hero_preview.png, microtile_preview.png, onepager_draft.pdf.

Samir - Marketing: Thanks Ava — will review and post copy edits tomorrow morning. Lina, Jamal, please flag any redlines by 10am PT.

Riley (PM): Minor ask — include a fallback illustration for low-bandwidth pages (SVG minimal). Ava, can you add a 1-color svg simplified hero?

Ava (Design): Yep — adding a simplified SVG and an AA color-check.

DesignOps Bot: Brand-check: primary logo clearspace ok, typographic hierarchy passes, but use secondary copy weight for the microtile callout to maintain legibility at small sizes.

Samir - Marketing: Awesome. One last note — in the hero, swap "latency" with "predictable latency" per previous comms. I'll keep this thread updated with legal and localization status. :email:

Ava (Design): Copy changes noted. Uploading revised frames in ~3h.

Lina (Growth): Thanks everyone. If the one-pager is approved, I'll craft the SDR email + 2x social captions and drop them here for quick QA.

Samir - Marketing: Perfect — that's the plan. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :tada:
